common.errorCheckDetails: Check the details you entered and try again.
common.errorRequestLinkFailed: Could not request a new link just now. Try again in a moment.

landing.heroSubhead: An immutable check-in/out ledger. Passkeys, QR and kiosk flows make entry effortless; server-authoritative time and a tamper-evident audit trail make the record impossible to quietly rewrite.
landing.visitorPrompt: Here to check in? Point your phone's camera at the QR code posted at your location — it opens your check-in directly.
landing.visitorScanLink: If it doesn't open, scan it here
landing.pairingHeading: Frictionless at the door. Certain in the record.
landing.pairingSubhead: Most systems trade one for the other — a fast turnstile with a soft log, or a rigorous log nobody wants to use. The same event is both here, and that pairing is the whole product.
landing.qrDetail: Printed room codes or live kiosk
landing.footerTagline: Secure check-in logging · Immutable by design

login.subhead: Staff and admin access to the console.
login.authSubhead: Sign in to manage locations, audit the ledger, and invite your team.
login.reasonSignedOutOthersTitle: Every other session on this account has ended.
login.reasonSignedOutOthersBody: Sign in again to continue on this device. Every browser and phone with an old cookie will land here on its next request — usually within a minute of you pressing the button.
login.reasonSessionExpiredTitle: You've been signed out on this device.
login.reasonSessionExpiredBody: Your session ended — either the 14-day sign-in expired or someone on this account ended every session. Sign back in to continue.
login.reasonSessionRevokedBody: The session on this device was revoked from Settings → Security. If that wasn't you, sign in and end every session immediately.
login.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.errorNoMatch: That email and password do not match an account.
login.errorRateLimited429: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.errorEnterEmailFirst: Enter your email address first, then sign in with your passkey.
login.errorNoPasskeyRegistered: No passkey is registered for this account.
login.errorPasskeyVerifyFailed: That passkey could not be verified.
login.errorPasskeySignInFailed: Passkey sign-in failed. Try your password instead.
login.noPasswordYetTitle: This account has no password yet
login.noPasswordYetBodyAdmin: An administrator created it for you. Set a password to sign in.
login.linkOnWayTo: A link to set your password is on its way to {email}.
login.verifyEmailTitle: Verify your email before signing in
login.newVerificationOnWay: A new verification link is on its way to {email}.

register.authSubhead: Create a team, model your buildings and rooms, and start recording entries that cannot be quietly rewritten.
register.title: Create your workspace
register.subtitle: Start a new team — you will be its owner.
register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong creating your account. Try again in a moment.
register.verificationOnWayTo: If that address can be registered, a verification link is on its way to {email}. It expires in one hour. Verify it, then sign in.
register.accountCreatedMailFailed: Your account was created, but this server could not send the verification email to {email}. Ask your administrator to check the mail settings — your account is safe in the meantime, and you can request a new link once mail is working.
register.nothingArrived: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder first — if it still isn't there in a minute or two, ask us to send it again.
register.linkRequestedAgain: Another link was requested. It should arrive shortly.
register.tryDifferentAddressWontHelp: Trying a different address will not help — the problem is the mail server, not your address.

forgotPassword.subheadDone: For accounts that exist and are already signed in once, a reset link arrives at the address on file.
forgotPassword.mailNotSendingTitle: The mail server is not sending
forgotPassword.resetLinkOnWay: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It's single-use and expires in one hour.
forgotPassword.mailNotConfiguredBody: This server is not configured to send mail, so no reset link was sent. Contact your administrator — they can reissue the account's set-password link from the members list.
forgotPassword.authSubhead: Enter the address you sign in with. If it maps to an account, a one-hour, single-use reset link goes to that inbox.
forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We answer the same way for every address, so this page never confirms or denies whether an account exists.
forgotPassword.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
forgotPassword.errorRequestFailed: Could not request a reset link. Try again in a moment.

resetPassword.authSubhead: Reset links are single-use and expire in one hour. Setting a new password signs you in and ends every other active session on this account.
resetPassword.expiredBody: Reset links last 1 hour. Request a new one and it will arrive at the same address.
resetPassword.validBody: Choose a new password. Signing in ends every other active session on this account.
resetPassword.errorGeneric: Could not reset password. Try again in a moment.
resetPassword.newLinkOnWay: A new link is on its way
resetPassword.resetLinkOnWayTo: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
